 Order

This appeal under Section 71 (6) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has been filed against the order dated 27.01.2025 passed by 9th District Judge, Gwalior in RCA. No. 07/2025 as well as order dated 29.11.2024 passed by Adjudicating Officer, Gwalior in Case No. Q/Food Safety/111/2023.
The sample of curd and milk collected from the appellant were found to be of substandard quality.
It is submitted by counsel for appellant that although the Adjudicating officer has imposed penalty of Rs. 2,00,000/- but the Appellate Court has reduced it to Rs. 1,00,000/-.
The appellant is a petty trader and accordingly, it is prayed that penalty of Rs. 1,00,000/- may further be reduced.
Considered the submissions made by counsel for appellant.
The citizens of India are entitled for unadulterated goods up to the standard in the FSSA.
Deviation from the standard fixed in FSSA is against NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:30053 2 MSA-6-2025 the mankind.
The appellate Court has already shown undue sympathetic view towards the appellant by reducing the penalty from Rs. 2,00,000/- to Rs. 1,00,000/-.
No good ground has been pointed out by the Counsel for the appellant to further reduce the amount of penalty.
Accordingly, orders dated 27.01.2025 and 29.11.2024 are hereby affirmed.
